A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same S2MV work, with matching authors, method and retained experiments. Their main text, figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–F are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original S2MV benchmark comparisons, component ablations, attention visualizations and unseen-domain generation results, including numerical results in Tables 1–2.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds a FLUX+Qwen comparison in Table 2 and higher-resolution retraining results in Appendix F.

M1.justification: The Wan backbone, parallel CA3 adapters, PRoPE conditioning, LoRA adaptation, frame replication and sparse correspondence-loss curriculum remain unchanged. The additional baseline and higher-resolution experiment do not establish a change to the proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same FS-COCO-derived S2MV data and the same TU-Berlin and InkScenes/InstantStyle generalization domains. Frontal-view scoring and higher-resolution retraining extend evaluation within this coverage.

E2.justification: v2 adds FLUX.2-dev plus Qwen Image Edit Angles as an evaluated competitor in Section 4.3/Table 2; this pairing previously served as the data-generation pipeline. SEVA and ViewCrafter remain in the quantitative comparisons, although ViewCrafter's cat-example row is removed from Figure 8.

E3.justification: New Table 2 separately evaluates frontal and 33-view outputs, introducing frontal sketch-fidelity mIoU as a reported evaluation metric. Appendix F adds retraining at 576×576. The original splits, 480×480 main configuration and existing comparison protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix F adds a preliminary resolution-sensitivity experiment through 576×576 retraining, previously left to future work. The existing component ablations, attention analysis and unseen-domain demonstrations are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report three-seed averaging, which also applies to the new FLUX+Qwen comparison. There is no reported increase in repeated-run counts or introduction of confidence intervals, significance tests or other uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: The original benchmark, ablation and timing values remain unchanged. New Table 2 reports Ours versus FLUX+Qwen: frontal mIoU 0.353 versus 0.338, multi-view FID 19.12 versus 51.77, and Corr-Acc 0.191 versus 0.174. Appendix F adds 576×576 results: PSNR 12.31, FID 17.92 and Corr-Acc 0.205. These are additional results, not replacements for Table 1 scores. Figure 8 removes the ViewCrafter cat outputs.

T1.justification: The mathematical objectives, camera/PRoPE constructions and Appendix B projection equations remain unchanged. The expanded CAMEO discussion numerically illustrates the existing dense-versus-sparse complexity argument without introducing a new formal result.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same task novelty, three principal contributions, single-stage generation claim and headline performance claims. The added experiments provide support without redefining these core contributions.

C2.justification: New Section 4.3 attributes gains to the sketch-to-frontal bottleneck, five-seed curation and LoRA absorbing curated data statistics, extending that argument to other two-stage pipelines. Section 2 adds claims about separating geometry supervision from appearance learning. Appendix F interprets higher-resolution results as evidence against an architectural quality ceiling; earlier limitations remain.

D1.justification: The supplementary access instructions change from an offline ZIP viewer at supp_vis/index.html to an interactive gallery on the project page. Actual resource availability cannot be verified from the PDFs. Existing implementation, hyperparameter and hardware disclosures are retained.

R1.justification: Section 2 expands the comparison with already-cited CAMEO from two distinctions to four axes: supervision location, computational scaling, correspondence source and backbone. The cited-work membership is unchanged; SketchingReality's venue-to-preprint reference update concerns the same work.

P1.justification: v2 adds an experimental subsection, expands the CAMEO paragraph, renumbers subsequent subsections and shortens the main limitations paragraph while retaining its details in Appendix F. Other prose and the overall document organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves before the abstract, and a new table groups frontal and multi-view metrics. Figures 5, 8 and 9 rearrange existing examples: Figure 5 expands to three cases, the lady example is duplicated, and the cat's ViewCrafter row disappears. Other displays are retained with resizing and page reflow.

improvement.justification: The FLUX+Qwen comparison addresses a relevant missing comparator, and Appendix F adds preliminary evidence about resolution scaling, modestly improving empirical completeness. These gains are tempered by incomplete documentation of the new comparison, unexplained differences between its Ours scores and Table 1, and removal of one qualitative ViewCrafter comparison. The new causal interpretations are stronger than the experiments directly establish.
